title: CCP-DP: Cross-cluster context-guided phase dynamic programming for DNA storage sequence reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.36559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Motivation: DNA data storage offers high information density and long-term stability, but accurate sequence reconstruction remains challenging under limited sequencing coverage and strong insertion, deletion, and substitution (IDS) noise. Existing reconstruction methods mainly rely on local evidence within individual read clusters. When sequencing coverage is low or indel-induced phase shifts become pronounced, such local evidence may be insufficient to distinguish closely competing candidate sequences.   Results: We present Cross-Cluster Context-Guided Phase Dynamic Programming (CCP-DP), which uses dataset-level cross-cluster information to complement cluster-local evidence and selectively refines ambiguous provisional consensuses. Under the main benchmark settings, CCP-DP achieved exact reconstruction rates of 95.36%-99.98% and outperformed existing methods on multiple datasets. translated_title: CCP-DP：用于DNA存储序列重建的跨簇上下文引导相位动态规划
translated_abstract: 动机：DNA数据存储具有高信息密度和长期稳定性，但在有限的测序覆盖率和较强的插入、删除与替换（IDS）噪声下，精确的序列重建仍然具有挑战性。现有的重建方法主要依赖于单个读段簇内的局部证据。当测序覆盖率较低或由插入/缺失引起的相位偏移变得显著时，这类局部证据可能不足以区分高度接近的相互竞争的候选序列。结果：我们提出了跨簇上下文引导相位动态规划（CCP-DP），该方法利用数据集层面的跨簇信息来补充簇内局部证据，并有选择地对模糊的临时共识序列进行精修。在主要基准测试设置下，CCP-DP实现了95.36%–99.98%的精确重建率，并在多个数据集上优于现有方法。在5×覆盖率下，CCP-DP提高了精确重建……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CCP-DP方法，利用数据集层面的跨簇上下文信息补充簇内局部证据，通过相位动态规划在低覆盖率和强IDS噪声条件下显著提升DNA存储序列的精确重建率（95.36%–99.98%），性能优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CCP-DP, which leverages dataset-level cross-cluster context information to complement cluster-local evidence through phase dynamic programming, achieving superior exact DNA storage sequence reconstruction rates (95.36%–99.98%) under low coverage and strong IDS noise.
